title: Search: a lost person in a clearing
problem_line: A sector of woodland, a person somewhere in it, and a sweep that must not call anything clear.

beats.caption: Sectors carry a probability of area. The pilot sweeps the first one at 30 m, camera straight down.
A person in a clearing: flagged once for review, never auto-confirmed.

success_line: Found and queued for a person to confirm; the swept sector keeps a probability.
